q1.title: Why does Ethio-Brew exist?
q1.content: Ethio-Brew exists to bridge the massive gap between the birthplace of coffee and global consumers. Historically, Ethiopian coffee has been commoditized and mixed, losing its unique regional identities.

q2.title: Why is Ethiopian coffee globally important?
q2.content: Ethiopia is the genetic birthplace of Coffea arabica. Unlike other regions where coffee was introduced, Ethiopia has thousands of undocumented heirloom varieties growing wild in its forests.

q3.title: Why does supporting farmers matter?
q3.content: Coffee is the backbone of the Ethiopian economy, yet the farmers who cultivate these world-class beans often receive the smallest fraction of the profit.

q4.title: Why is a digital coffee marketplace needed?
q4.content: In an era of instant global connectivity, the coffee trade has remained unnecessarily opaque. A digital marketplace provides transparency and removes geographical barriers.
